name: Account Management Confirmation 5
definition: Information about the type of request or instruction.

AccountApplicationIdentification.name: Account Application Identification
AccountApplicationIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier of the account opening or modification instruction at application level.

ClientReference.name: Client Reference
ClientReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of a transaction, for example, a transfer, as assigned by the investor or account owner.

CounterpartyReference.name: Counterparty Reference
CounterpartyReference.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction, for example, a transfer, as allocated by the counterparty.

ExistingAccountIdentification.name: Existing Account Identification
ExistingAccountIdentification.definition: Account to which the account opening is related.
